# Town of Westfield municipal roster backfill -- Vermont
# municipal fan-out batch 26; issue #163 (VT master tracking).

sources.note: Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Vermont Selectboard Members' directory (updated June 5, 2026): names Jacques Couture (Chair), Richard Degre, and Dennis Vincent for Westfield's three-member board

Town of Westfield, Town Officers/Departments page (westfield.vt.gov; the page labels each office '(elected)' or appointed): 'Selectboard: (elected): Jacques Couture, Chair (expires 2028); Dennis Vincent, Vice-Chair (expires 2029); Richard Degre (expires 2027)'

Town of Westfield, Town Officers/Departments page (westfield.vt.gov; the page labels each office '(elected)' or appointed): 'Town Clerk: Niki Dunn (appointed by Selectboard to fill one year of an unexpired term - expires 2027)' -- the office is elective but the current holder is an appointee. The Secretary of State's clerk spreadsheet gives her full name as Nicole Dunn; the Guide's 'LaDonna Dunn' is her Assistant Town Clerk (appointed by the Clerk), a staff role with no post. Dunn also holds a justice of the peace seat; one record carries both
Town of Westfield, Town Officers/Departments page (westfield.vt.gov; the page labels each office '(elected)' or appointed): 'Town Treasurer: Lisa Deslandes (elected-expires 2027)'

sources.note: Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Vermont Justices of the Peace' listing (updated December 4, 2025): lists four Westfield justices of the peace: Nicole Dunn, Anne Lazor, Michael Piper, and Pat Sagui

Town of Westfield, Town Officers/Departments page (westfield.vt.gov; the page labels each office '(elected)' or appointed): the town's justice of the peace list names Karen Blais, Niki Dunn, Michael Piper, and Pat Sagui -- it swaps Blais in for the certified Anne Lazor at equal count. The certified listing governs: Lazor is seated and Blais (minted as a library trustee) is held as a straggler for this office (divergence flagged on #163)
